description: Dual Card Pro compares two KPIs with options for advanced formatting. Use Dual Card Pro to compare two measures.This visual provides rich formatting options with automatic and manual conditional formatting for background, border, data and category labels. With this you can control the precision on the positioning and formatting of the visual elements like border,label, fill etc. Visual requires two measures. First one is referred as data measure and second as comparison measure. Key features: Card orientation - Supports Horizontal or Vertical Display blank measure as static value. Supports large font up to 150px. Conditional formatting: Identify and highlight data points,trends based on the rules for data and comparison label and category.. Label & Category: Improve readability,control position and size for data and comparison measures. Fill: Compare data points at a glance by filling the space of label,category to indicate the magnitude. Supports visual cross filter & synchronization.
